Describe where a version of the package comes from

Source: R/sources.R
sources.Rd

These constructors only describe a source. Nothing is downloaded, exported or built until prepare_versions(), which says what it fetches and where.

Usage

cran_release(repos = NULL)

cran_version(version, repos = NULL)

installed_version(lib = NULL, repos = NULL)

tarball(path)

git_ref(repo, ref = "HEAD", subdir = NULL)

local_path(path)

Arguments

repos

CRAN mirror. Defaults to the CRAN entry of getOption("repos"), or the cloud mirror when that is unset.

version

Version string, for example "0.2.1".

lib

Library to look in for installed_version(); defaults to .libPaths(), searched in order as library() does.

path

Path to a tarball (tarball()) or a package folder (local_path()).

repo

Path to a git repository.

ref

Git ref: a branch, tag or commit. Only committed content is exported.

subdir

Folder of the package inside the repository, if it is not the root.

Value

An object of class pkgdossier_source.

Details

  • cran_release(): the version on CRAN now.

  • cran_version(): a given CRAN version, current or archived.

  • installed_version(): the version installed in your library, fetched as source from CRAN (or its archive) by prepare_versions(): what you have now, to compare with cran_release() before upgrading. The installed copy itself is never used, as both versions are built from source the same way. A version that did not come from CRAN (a development version from GitHub or R-universe) stops with what to write instead, as does a package that is not installed; with candidate = cran_release(), so does an installed version that is already the current release.

  • tarball(): a source tarball on disk (for example one downloaded from CRAN earlier).

  • git_ref(): a commit, branch or tag of a git repository, exported with git archive and built with R CMD build inside the work folder, never in the repository.

  • local_path(): a package source folder, built with R CMD build (which builds from a copy, so nothing is written into the folder).

Examples

cran_version("0.2.1")
#> <pkgdossier source> CRAN version 0.2.1
# what changes for you if you upgrade: describing reads nothing yet
dossier("ggplot2", base = installed_version(), candidate = cran_release())
#> <pkgdossier dossier> ggplot2
#>   base:      the installed version, from CRAN
#>   candidate: CRAN release (current)
#>   scenarios: baseline vignettes; baseline help-page examples
#>   runs:      abba, 3 timed repeats per timed step, seed 20261027 set per step
#>   capture:   width 80, 100 dpi, LANGUAGE en
#>   collect:   default caps; default skipped classes
#>   deps:      shared, from the current library paths
#>   work:      /tmp/RtmpYzIdew/pkgdossier-ggplot2
git_ref("path/to/MAIHDA", "main")
#> <pkgdossier source> git path/to/MAIHDA @ main
